info.title: Rikkaus Wealth OS API
info.description: Versioned REST contract for the Rikkaus Wealth OS backend. Errors follow RFC 9457 with a urn:rikkaus:problem: type.

servers.description: Relative to the deployment's own base URL

get.summary: Read the reporting currency and the declared USD/VND rate
get.description: Returns VND as the fixed reporting currency together with the rate the user declared, the date they declared it effective, and when the server stored that declaration. The three rate fields are null until a rate has been declared; that is the rate-needed state, not an error.

put.description: Stores the rate and the date the user says it took effect, and stamps the server's own record of when it was stored. The effective date must not be in the future; it is judged as a Vietnamese civil date, not a UTC one.

get.summary: Read one liability
get.description: Returns the liability when the signed-in user owns it. An identifier belonging to another user answers not-found with the same body a missing identifier produces.

400.description: The identifier in the path is not a UUID

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

put.description: Replaces every field except the category, which is chosen once when the liability is created. An omitted optional field is cleared, because this is a replacement rather than a patch: omitting collateralAssetId unlinks the collateral. The same rules as creation apply, and the collateral is re-checked against the signed-in user.

200.description: The liability as it now stands

400.description: A required field is missing, an amount is negative or too precise, a recurring payment is not positive or is half-stated, a date is inconsistent, or the collateral is not an asset the signed-in user owns

delete.description: Deletes the liability when the signed-in user owns it. Cash-flow entries linked to it are kept with linkedLiabilityId cleared, and while there is at least one the delete is refused with 409 linked-records, carrying the same impact GET .../deletion-impact returns, unless the request says confirm=true. A liability nothing refers to deletes without it. Nothing is recoverable afterwards. A second delete of the same identifier answers not-found, the same answer any unknown identifier gets. Two deletes that overlap give one 204 and not-found to the rest rather than a server error. The pledged asset, if any, is untouched.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: true once the user has seen and accepted the linked-record effects. Absent or false: a liability with linked entries is not deleted.

400.description: The identifier in the path is not a UUID, or confirm is not a boolean

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

404.description: No such liability, it belongs to another user, or a concurrent request removed it first

409.description: linked-records: cash-flow entries would be unlinked and confirm=true was not sent. Nothing was deleted; the impact member says what the confirmed delete would do

An omitted optional member — recurrence, endDate, linkedAssetId, linkedLiabilityId, notes — is cleared, because this is a replacement rather than a patch. Nothing refers to an entry, so there is never a linked-record confirmation; GET .../deletion-impact names the computed views that stop including it. Nothing is recoverable afterwards. A second delete of the same identifier answers not-found, the same answer any unknown identifier gets. Two deletes that overlap, which is what a double-tapped confirm button produces, give one 204 and not-found to the rest rather than a server error.

get.summary: Read one asset
get.description: Returns the asset when the signed-in user owns it. An identifier belonging to another user answers not-found with the same body a missing identifier produces, so the response cannot be used to discover which identifiers exist.

400.description: The identifier in the path is not a UUID

401.description: No access token, or it has expired or been revoked

404.description: No such asset, or it belongs to another user

406.description: The requested media type cannot be produced

put.description: Replaces the name, liquidity, the optional common fields and the four instrument fields. An omitted optional field is cleared, because this is a replacement rather than a patch, which is how a ticker recorded by mistake is removed. The instrument fields are judged against the asset's stored category, because the category is not editable here. The current value, its currency, the valuation date and the category are not editable here: a new value is recorded through POST /api/v1/assets/{assetId}/valuations and the asset follows it, and the category is chosen once when the asset is created.

400.description: The name or liquidity is missing, a value is negative or too precise, a quantity is not positive, the purchase date is in the future or later than the asset's stored valuation date, or an instrument field was sent for an asset whose stored category does not accept it

delete.description: Deletes the asset and its valuation history when the signed-in user owns it. When a liability uses the asset as collateral or a cash-flow entry is linked to it, those records are kept with the reference cleared, and the delete is refused with 409 linked-records, carrying the same impact GET .../deletion-impact returns, unless the request says confirm=true. An asset nothing refers to deletes without it. Nothing is recoverable afterwards. A second delete of the same identifier answers not-found, the same answer any unknown identifier gets. Two deletes that overlap, which is what a double-tapped confirm button produces, give one 204 and not-found to the rest rather than a server error.

parameters.description: true once the user has seen and accepted the linked-record effects. Absent or false: an asset with linked records is not deleted.

404.description: No such asset, it belongs to another user, or a concurrent request removed it first

409.description: linked-records: other records would be unlinked and confirm=true was not sent. Nothing was deleted; the impact member says what the confirmed delete would do

get.summary: List the signed-in user's liabilities
get.description: Returns every liability the viewer owns, soonest next payment first, those with no next payment date after them, and then by name. An empty catalog is an empty array and a 200, not a 404. Amounts are reported in each liability's own currency; converting a USD balance to VND is the client's, using the rate from GET /api/v1/settings/exchange-rate. The optional q, category, currency and sort parameters narrow and reorder the catalog; without them the response is the whole catalog in the default order.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Searches the name and notes. Substring match that ignores letter case and Vietnamese diacritics, so "thao dien" finds "Căn hộ Thảo Điền". Surrounding spaces are ignored and an empty value means no search. % and _ are literal characters, not wildcards. At most 120 characters; a longer value or one containing U+0000 is rejected as validation-failed naming q.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Keeps the liabilities in these categories. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas; a record matching any of them is kept, and different parameters must all match. Values are the exact constant names. An empty value is ignored; any other unknown value is rejected as validation-failed naming this parameter.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Keeps the liabilities in these currencies. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas; a record matching any of them is kept, and different parameters must all match. Values are the exact constant names. An empty value is ignored; any other unknown value is rejected as validation-failed naming this parameter.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: nextPaymentDate (the default) lists the soonest payment first; -nextPaymentDate the latest first; name and -name by name. A liability with no next payment date is last in both date orders. One key; a leading - sorts descending. Ties are broken by the default order and then by id, so the order is stable between requests. Any other key, or more than one, is rejected as validation-failed naming sort.

get.summary: List the signed-in user's cash-flow entries
get.description: Returns every income and expense entry the viewer owns, newest effective date first and then newest created first. An empty catalog is an empty array and a 200, not a 404. Amounts are reported in each entry's own currency; converting a USD entry to VND is the client's, using the rate from GET /api/v1/settings/exchange-rate. A recurring entry is one row, not one row per month: the dates it falls on are GET /api/v1/cash-flow-occurrences. The optional q, entryType, category, timing, recurrence, currency, effectiveFrom, effectiveTo and sort parameters narrow and reorder the catalog; without them the response is the whole catalog in the default order.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Searches the notes, the entry's one free-text field. Substring match that ignores letter case and Vietnamese diacritics, so "thao dien" finds "Căn hộ Thảo Điền". Surrounding spaces are ignored and an empty value means no search. % and _ are literal characters, not wildcards. At most 120 characters; a longer value or one containing U+0000 is rejected as validation-failed naming q.

parameters.name: entryType
parameters.description: Keeps the entries of these types. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas; a record matching any of them is kept, and different parameters must all match. Values are the exact constant names. An empty value is ignored; any other unknown value is rejected as validation-failed naming this parameter.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Keeps the entries in these categories. A category that does not belong to a type kept by entryType simply matches nothing. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas; a record matching any of them is kept, and different parameters must all match. Values are the exact constant names. An empty value is ignored; any other unknown value is rejected as validation-failed naming this parameter.

parameters.name: timing
parameters.description: Keeps one-time or recurring entries. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas; a record matching any of them is kept, and different parameters must all match. Values are the exact constant names. An empty value is ignored; any other unknown value is rejected as validation-failed naming this parameter.

parameters.name: recurrence
parameters.description: Keeps the recurring entries with these recurrences; a one-time entry has none and is never kept by this filter. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas; a record matching any of them is kept, and different parameters must all match. Values are the exact constant names. An empty value is ignored; any other unknown value is rejected as validation-failed naming this parameter.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Keeps the entries in these currencies. Repeat the parameter or separate values with commas; a record matching any of them is kept, and different parameters must all match. Values are the exact constant names. An empty value is ignored; any other unknown value is rejected as validation-failed naming this parameter.

parameters.name: effectiveFrom
parameters.description: Keeps the entries whose stored effective date is on or after this date, as YYYY-MM-DD. It filters the start date of a recurring entry, not the dates it falls on; those are GET /api/v1/cash-flow-occurrences.

parameters.name: effectiveTo
parameters.description: Keeps the entries whose stored effective date is on or before this date, as YYYY-MM-DD. Must not be before effectiveFrom.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: -effectiveDate (the default) lists the newest effective date first and then the newest created; effectiveDate the oldest first. One key; a leading - sorts descending. Ties are broken by the default order and then by id, so the order is stable between requests. Any other key, or more than one, is rejected as validation-failed naming sort.

post.description: Exchanges a refresh token for a new access token and a new refresh token. The presented token is single-use: presenting it again is treated as evidence that it leaked and revokes the whole session. A native client sends the token in the body. The web client sends no body token, the `rikkaus_refresh` cookie, and `X-Rikkaus-Client: web`; the rotated token comes back as a new cookie.

parameters.description: Send `web` from the browser client. The refresh token is then set as the HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict cookie `rikkaus_refresh` (Path=/api/v1/auth) and omitted from the body. Omit the header from a native client to keep the token in the body.

method.remainingMonths: n = calendar months from the month after asOfDate through the month of targetDate, both included; contributions arrive at the end of each month. A target date before asOfDate is EXPIRED; a target date later this month leaves n = 0 and is DUE_THIS_MONTH.

method.projectedAmount: fromAllocated = currentAllocatedAmount × g; fromContributions = plannedMonthlyContribution × (g − 1) / r, or plannedMonthlyContribution × n when r = 0; total = fromAllocated + fromContributions; gapToTarget = total − targetAmount.

effectiveDate.description: The date you confirm this rate took effect. Must not be in the future.

ExchangeRateResponse.description: The reporting currency and the user-declared USD/VND exchange rate.

baseCurrency.description: The reporting currency. Fixed to VND for MVP 1A.

usdToVndRate.description: How many VND one USD buys, as declared by the user. Null until declared.

effectiveDate.description: The date the user declares the rate took effect. Not the time it was stored.

updatedAt.description: When the server stored the declaration.

UpdateProfileRequest.description: Change the display name. The only editable profile field.

displayName.description: The name to show. Trimmed before storing.

email.description: From the verified Google identity token. Read-only here.

displayName.description: The name the user chose, or the Google name if they never chose one.

UpdateLiabilityRequest.description: Replace a liability's editable fields. The category is not editable.

name.description: What the user calls this liability.

outstandingBalance.description: What is still owed, as the user now states it. Zero is allowed, negative is not.

currency.description: The currency the balance and the recurring payment are expressed in.

interestRate.description: Nominal annual interest rate in percent. Omit to clear it.

startDate.description: When the liability began. Omit to clear it.

maturityDate.description: When it is due to be settled. Must not be before the start date. Omit to clear it.

recurringPaymentAmount.description: The total due each period. Must be greater than zero and come with a frequency. Omit to clear the schedule.

recurringPaymentFrequency.description: How often the recurring payment falls due. Must come with an amount.

nextPaymentDate.description: The next date a payment is due, inside the term when the term is given. Omit to clear it.

collateralAssetId.description: The asset pledged against this liability; must be the signed-in user's. Omit to unlink.

notes.description: Anything the user wants to remember. Omit to clear it.

LiabilityResponse.description: A liability in the signed-in user's catalog.

name.description: What the user calls this liability.

category.description: One of the six liability categories.

outstandingBalance.description: What is still owed, in its own currency.

currency.description: The currency the amounts are expressed in.

interestRate.description: Nominal annual rate in percent. Null when not recorded.

startDate.description: When the liability began. Null when not recorded.

maturityDate.description: When it is due to be settled. Null when not recorded.

recurringPaymentAmount.description: The total due each period. Null when there is no recurring payment.

recurringPaymentFrequency.description: How often it falls due. Null when there is no recurring payment.

nextPaymentDate.description: The next date a payment is due. Null when not recorded.

collateralAssetId.description: The pledged asset, owned by the same user. Null when none, or when that asset was deleted.

notes.description: The user's own note. Null when not recorded.
notes.example: Thế chấp căn hộ Thảo Điền.

createdAt.description: When the server first stored this liability.

updatedAt.description: When the server last stored a change to it.

GoalRequest.description: Create or replace a goal. The same fields for every template.

name.description: What the user calls this goal.

type.description: Which of the seven templates this goal follows. Editable.

targetAmount.description: The amount to reach, in VND. Must be greater than zero.

currentAllocatedAmount.description: What has already been set aside for this goal, in VND. Zero or more, and never above the target amount. Omit for nothing set aside yet, which is stored as 0.00.

targetDate.description: The date to reach the goal by. When created, or when changed, it must be after today as a Vietnamese civil date; keeping a stored date is always allowed.

plannedMonthlyContribution.description: What the user plans to add each month, in VND. Zero or more. Omit when not stated; that is kept distinct from zero.

expectedAnnualReturnPercent.description: The user's own assumption for the annual return, in percent, from 0 to 30. Omit for no assumption. Informational only; never a promise.

GoalResponse.description: A financial goal owned by the signed-in user. Inputs only; projections are issue #89.

name.description: What the user calls this goal.

type.description: Which of the seven templates this goal follows.

currency.description: The currency every amount is in. Always VND.

currentAllocatedAmount.description: What has been set aside so far. 0.00 when nothing yet.

targetDate.description: The date to reach the goal by.

plannedMonthlyContribution.description: Planned monthly contribution. Null when not stated.

expectedAnnualReturnPercent.description: The user's assumed annual return in percent. Null when no assumption.

createdAt.description: When the server first stored this goal.

updatedAt.description: When the server last stored a change to it.

CashFlowEntryRequest.description: Create or replace a cash-flow entry. The same body serves both.

entryType.description: Whether the money comes in or goes out. Decides the sign; the amount is always positive.

category.description: One of the seven income or nine expense categories. Must belong to the entry type given.

amount.description: The amount, in this entry's currency. Greater than zero.

currency.description: The currency the amount is expressed in. No conversion is stored; the client converts with the rate from the settings resource.

timing.description: ONE_TIME or RECURRING. Decides whether recurrence and endDate may be present.

recurrence.description: How often a recurring entry repeats. Required when timing is RECURRING and must be omitted when it is ONE_TIME.

effectiveDate.description: The date a one-time entry applies, or the first date of a recurring one. May be in the future.

endDate.description: The last date a recurring entry applies. Only for RECURRING; omit for open-ended. Must not be before effectiveDate.

linkedAssetId.description: An asset of the signed-in user this entry refers to, such as the apartment a rent comes from. Omit to leave it unlinked, or to clear it on PUT.

linkedLiabilityId.description: A liability of the signed-in user this entry refers to, such as the mortgage an interest payment belongs to. Must not be sent together with linkedAssetId. Omit to leave it unlinked, or to clear it on PUT.

notes.description: Anything the user wants to remember about it. Omit to clear it on PUT.

CashFlowEntryResponse.description: A cash-flow entry in the signed-in user's catalog.

category.description: One of the sixteen categories, always of the entry's type.

amount.description: The amount, in the entry's own currency. Always positive.

currency.description: The currency the amount is expressed in.

recurrence.description: MONTHLY, QUARTERLY or YEARLY for a recurring entry. Null for a one-time one.

effectiveDate.description: The date a one-time entry applies, or the first date of a recurring one.

endDate.description: The last date a recurring entry applies. Null when open-ended or one-time.

linkedAssetId.description: The user's asset this entry refers to. Null when unlinked.

linkedLiabilityId.description: The user's liability this entry refers to. Null when unlinked.

notes.description: The user's own note. Null when not recorded.

createdAt.description: When the server first stored this entry.

updatedAt.description: When the server last stored a change to it.

UpdateAssetMetadataRequest.description: Replace an asset's editable metadata. The valuation is not editable here.

name.description: What the user calls this asset.

liquidity.description: How readily the user judges this asset can be turned into cash.

purchaseValue.description: Purchase value or cost basis, in the asset's own currency. Omit to clear it.

purchaseDate.description: When the asset was acquired. Must not be in the future and must not be later than the asset's stored valuation date. Omit to clear it.

quantity.description: Units held. Must be greater than zero when present. Omit to clear it.

institution.description: Where the asset is held or stored. Omit to clear it.

notes.description: Anything the user wants to remember. Omit to clear it.
notes.example: Đã chuyển sang kỳ hạn 6 tháng.

symbol.description: Ticker, ISIN or fund code, as the user types it. Nothing resolves it against a market. Omit to clear it. Accepted for LISTED_SECURITIES, BOND, INVESTMENT_FUND and OTHER_ASSET; any other category refuses it.

costPerUnit.description: What one unit cost, in this asset's own currency. Entered by the user and never multiplied by the quantity. Accepted for the same four categories as the symbol.

currentPricePerUnit.description: What one unit is worth now, in this asset's own currency. Entered by the user; currentValue is a separate field and is never derived from this one. Accepted for the same four categories as the symbol.

interestRate.description: Interest rate or expected yield as a percent per year, so 6.2500 is 6.25%. No interest is accrued and no yield projected from it. Accepted for BOND, TERM_DEPOSIT and OTHER_ASSET only: a listed security has no rate, and a fund's expected return belongs in the notes.

AssetResponse.description: An asset in the signed-in user's catalog.

name.description: What the user calls this asset.

category.description: One of the eleven asset categories.

currentValue.description: What the asset is worth, in its own currency: the value of the current record in its valuation history.

currency.description: The currency the values are expressed in.

valuationDate.description: The date the user states the value was accurate: the effective date of the current valuation record.

liquidity.description: How readily the user judges it can be turned into cash.

purchaseValue.description: Purchase value or cost basis. Null when not recorded.

purchaseDate.description: When the asset was acquired. Null when not recorded.

quantity.description: Units held. Null when not recorded.

institution.description: Where it is held or stored. Null when not recorded.

notes.description: The user's own note. Null when not recorded.
notes.example: Tiền gửi dự phòng bằng USD.

symbol.description: Ticker, ISIN or fund code. Null when not recorded.

costPerUnit.description: What one unit cost. Null when not recorded.

currentPricePerUnit.description: What one unit is worth now. Null when not recorded. currentValue is not derived from it.

interestRate.description: Interest rate or expected yield as a percent per year, so 6.2500 is 6.25%. Null when not recorded.

createdAt.description: When the server first stored this asset.

updatedAt.description: When the server last stored a change to it.

CreateLiabilityRequest.description: Create a liability. The category is chosen here and cannot be changed later.

name.description: What the user calls this liability.

category.description: One of the six liability categories.

outstandingBalance.description: What is still owed, in this liability's currency, as the user states it. Zero is allowed, negative is not.

currency.description: The currency the balance and the recurring payment are expressed in. No conversion happens here; the client holds the declared rate.

interestRate.description: Nominal annual interest rate in percent, as the user states it: 8.5 means 8.5 % per year. Recorded only; nothing accrues from it.

maturityDate.description: When it is due to be settled. Must not be before the start date.

recurringPaymentAmount.description: The total due each period, in the liability's currency. Must be greater than zero, and must come with a frequency.

recurringPaymentFrequency.description: How often the recurring payment falls due. Must come with an amount.

nextPaymentDate.description: The next date a payment is due. Must fall between the start and maturity dates when those are given. May be in the past.

collateralAssetId.description: The asset pledged against this liability. Must identify an asset the signed-in user owns; any other identifier is refused with the field named.

notes.description: Anything the user wants to remember about it.
notes.example: Thế chấp căn hộ Thảo Điền.

FeedbackRequest.description: Feedback sent from one screen of the app.

screen.description: The screen the feedback was sent from, as a route-like code: lowercase ASCII letters and digits in segments joined by '-' or '/', at most 64 characters.

category.description: What kind of feedback this is. Omit when the user did not choose one.

message.description: The user's own words. Surrounding blank space is removed; must not be blank, at most 2000 characters, and must not contain U+0000.
message.example: Màn hình danh mục tài sản không hiển thị tỷ giá cập nhật 12/09/2026 sau khi lưu.

screen.description: The screen code it was sent from.

category.description: BUG, IDEA, QUESTION or OTHER; null when the user did not choose one.

message.description: The user's own words, as stored.
message.example: Màn hình danh mục tài sản không hiển thị tỷ giá cập nhật 12/09/2026 sau khi lưu.

RefreshSessionRequest.description: Carries the refresh token identifying the session to renew or end.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token returned by the most recent sign-in or renewal. Required for native clients. The web client omits it (or the whole body) and sends the `rikkaus_refresh` cookie with `X-Rikkaus-Client: web` instead.

SessionResponse.description: A signed-in session: an access token, its lifetime, and the refresh token.

accessToken.description: Signed JWT to send as `Authorization: Bearer`.

expiresInSeconds.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

refreshToken.description: Single-use token for renewing the session. Rotated on every renewal. Present for native clients only; a request sent with `X-Rikkaus-Client: web` receives it in the HttpOnly `rikkaus_refresh` cookie and this field is omitted.

GoogleSignInRequest.description: Completes a Google sign-in started by the client.

authorizationCode.description: The authorization code Google returned to the client's redirect URI.

codeVerifier.description: The PKCE code verifier for the challenge sent when the flow started.

redirectUri.description: The redirect URI used to obtain the code. Must appear in the server's allowlist.

CreateAssetRequest.description: Create an asset with the fields every category shares.

name.description: What the user calls this asset.

category.description: One of the eleven asset categories.

currentValue.description: What the asset is worth, in this asset's currency. Entered by the user; there is no price feed. Zero is allowed, negative is not.

currency.description: The currency the values are expressed in. The reporting currency is separately fixed to VND and is read from the settings resource.

valuationDate.description: The date the user states this value was accurate. Must not be in the future, judged as a Vietnamese civil date.

usdToVndRate.description: The USD/VND rate the user applied to currentValue, kept with the first record of the valuation history as the rate used. Only for a USD asset, and only together with rateEffectiveDate.

rateEffectiveDate.description: The date the user states that rate took effect. Must not be in the future. Only together with usdToVndRate.

liquidity.description: How readily the user judges this asset can be turned into cash.

purchaseValue.description: Purchase value or cost basis, in the same currency.

purchaseDate.description: When the asset was acquired. Must not be in the future and must not be later than the valuation date.

quantity.description: Units held, where that is meaningful. Must be greater than zero.

institution.description: Where the asset is held or stored.

notes.description: Anything the user wants to remember about it.
notes.example: Tiền gửi dự phòng bằng USD.

symbol.description: Ticker, ISIN or fund code, as the user types it. Nothing resolves it against a market. Accepted for LISTED_SECURITIES, BOND, INVESTMENT_FUND and OTHER_ASSET; any other category refuses it.

costPerUnit.description: What one unit cost, in this asset's own currency. Entered by the user and never multiplied by the quantity. Accepted for the same four categories as the symbol.

currentPricePerUnit.description: What one unit is worth now, in this asset's own currency. Entered by the user; currentValue is a separate field and is never derived from this one. Accepted for the same four categories as the symbol.

interestRate.description: Interest rate or expected yield as a percent per year, so 6.2500 is 6.25%. No interest is accrued and no yield projected from it. Accepted for BOND, TERM_DEPOSIT and OTHER_ASSET only: a listed security has no rate, and a fund's expected return belongs in the notes.

RecordValuationRequest.description: Record what an asset is worth. Appended to the history; the asset's current value follows when this is the newest record.

value.description: What the asset is worth, in the asset's own currency. The original amount, never a converted one. Zero is allowed, negative is not.

currency.description: The currency of the value. Must be the asset's currency.

effectiveDate.description: The date the user states this value was true. Must not be in the future and not before the asset's purchase date, judged as a Vietnamese civil date. Decides whether this record becomes the current one.

usdToVndRate.description: The USD/VND rate the user applied to this value: a snapshot kept with the record, not a reference to the settings rate. Only on a USD record, and only together with rateEffectiveDate.

rateEffectiveDate.description: The date the user states that rate took effect. Must not be in the future. Only together with usdToVndRate.

note.description: Why this record exists. Required when correcting an earlier record; otherwise optional.
note.example: Cập nhật số dư sau khi đối chiếu sao kê.

correctsValuationId.description: The earlier record of this asset that this one corrects. The original is kept unchanged and stays readable; this record carries the reason in note.

AssetValuationResponse.description: One record in an asset's valuation history.

assetId.description: The asset this record belongs to.

value.description: What the asset was worth, in its own currency.

effectiveDate.description: The date the user states the value was true.

usdToVndRate.description: The USD/VND rate the user applied when recording this value. Null on a VND record, and null when the user did not capture it.

rateEffectiveDate.description: The date the user states that rate took effect. Null whenever usdToVndRate is.

note.description: The user's note, or the reason for a correction. Null when not given.
note.example: Cập nhật số dư sau khi đối chiếu sao kê.

correctsValuationId.description: The record this one corrects, when it is a correction. Null otherwise.

current.description: True on exactly one record of an asset: the one its current value, currency and valuation date are taken from. Latest effective date wins; between two on the same date, the later recorded.

recordedAt.description: When the server stored this record.

UpdateOnboardingRequest.description: Record progress through the guided onboarding. Send only what changed.

currentStep.description: The step the user is now viewing, 1 to 7 in the backbone order. The client resumes here next time.

dashboardReviewed.description: Whether the user has reviewed their first dashboard. true records the first review and keeps its moment if sent again; false withdraws it.

status.description: COMPLETED or DISMISSED ends the guided flow; IN_PROGRESS reopens it. Completion does not require every step to be done.

OnboardingResponse.description: The signed-in user's guided-onboarding checklist and where they are in it.

status.description: Where the user stands in the flow as a whole.

currentStep.description: The step the user last viewed, 1 to 7. 1 until the client records one.

steps.description: All seven steps, always in backbone order.

dashboardReviewedAt.description: When the user first reviewed their dashboard. Null until the client records it.

completedAt.description: When the user completed the flow. Null unless status is COMPLETED.

dismissedAt.description: When the user dismissed the flow. Null unless status is DISMISSED.

OnboardingStepState.description: One checklist step and whether it is done now.

key.description: Which step this is. The client maps it to its copy.

done.description: Whether the user's records satisfy this step right now. Deleting the last such record makes it false again.

WealthSnapshotAsset.description: An asset as the snapshot counts it.

value.description: The current value in the asset's own currency.

valueVnd.description: value in VND; null when USD and no rate is declared.

WealthSnapshotCategory.description: One asset category and the sum of its assets.

amountVnd.description: The sum, or null when a record is excluded.

knownAmountVnd.description: The sum of the converted records.

WealthSnapshotDue.description: One date a liability falls due.

dueKind.description: PAYMENT is nextPaymentDate; MATURITY is maturityDate.

amount.description: The recurring payment for PAYMENT, the outstanding balance for MATURITY, in the liability's currency. Null when no recurring payment is stated.

amountVnd.description: amount in VND; null when amount is null or it is USD without a declared rate.

WealthSnapshotExchangeRate.description: The declared rate, as used for every conversion in this snapshot.

effectiveDate.description: The date the user states the rate took effect.

WealthSnapshotKpis.description: The six KPIs of the dashboard.

totalAssets.description: Every asset's latest value, converted to VND.

totalLiabilities.description: Every liability's outstanding balance, converted to VND.

netWorth.description: totalAssets minus totalLiabilities; may be negative. Null when either amountVnd is null.

debtToAssetRatio.description: totalLiabilities / totalAssets as a fraction, six decimals, HALF_UP (0.127645 is 12.7645 %). Null when total assets are zero or either amountVnd is null.

liquidAssets.description: Assets whose liquidity is HIGH, converted to VND.

lastDataUpdate.description: The newest date in sourceDates; null when there is no source.

WealthSnapshotLargestAssets.description: The five largest assets by VND value.

items.description: At most five, in the order of assets: largest valueVnd, then Vietnamese name, then id.

excludedRecordCount.description: Assets that could not be ranked because they could not be converted.

WealthSnapshotLiability.description: A liability as the snapshot counts it.

outstandingBalanceVnd.description: outstandingBalance in VND; null when USD and no rate is declared.

updatedOn.description: The day, in timeZone, the liability was last saved.

WealthSnapshotLiquidity.description: One liquidity level and the sum of its assets.

amountVnd.description: The sum, or null when a record is excluded.

knownAmountVnd.description: The sum of the converted records.

WealthSnapshotRankedAsset.description: A ranked asset; the same figures as its row in assets.

WealthSnapshotResponse.description: The signed-in user's assets, liabilities and net worth in VND, with every line they are summed from.

asOfDate.description: Today in timeZone; the day the due-date window starts.

timeZone.description: The zone asOfDate is read in.

exchangeRate.description: The declared USD/VND rate every USD line is converted with; null when none is declared.

complete.description: False when at least one USD asset or liability could not be converted because no rate is declared. The affected totals are then null.

assetsByCategory.description: One row per category that has an asset, largest knownAmountVnd first, then by category. Not grouped into an other slice.

assetsByLiquidity.description: One row per liquidity level that has an asset, in the order HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW.

sourceDates.description: The date every source contributes, for the freshness screen. Newest first; on one day ASSET, LIABILITY, EXCHANGE_RATE, then by Vietnamese name and id.

assets.description: Every asset, largest valueVnd first (unconverted last), then by Vietnamese name, then id. Every asset total sums these.

liabilities.description: Every liability, largest outstandingBalanceVnd first (unconverted last), then by Vietnamese name, then id.

WealthSnapshotSourceDate.description: The date one source contributes to the snapshot.

sourceId.description: The asset or liability; null for EXCHANGE_RATE.

date.description: An asset's valuationDate, the day (in timeZone) a liability was last saved, or the rate's effectiveDate. The rate is listed only when it converted a line.

WealthSnapshotTotal.description: A sum over records that may include unconverted USD ones. amountVnd is null when any record is excluded; knownAmountVnd is always the sum of the converted records.

amountVnd.description: The total, or null when excludedRecordCount > 0.

knownAmountVnd.description: The sum of the records that were converted.

excludedRecordCount.description: Records left out for want of a declared rate.

WealthSnapshotUpcomingDues.description: Liability dates on or before asOfDate + windowDays, past ones included.

windowDays.description: How many days ahead of asOfDate count as upcoming.

items.description: By dueDate, PAYMENT before MATURITY, then Vietnamese name, then liabilityId.

ruleId.description: The rule. A stable constant the client maps to its copy.

status.description: ATTENTION when observed.value compares with threshold.value as threshold.comparison says; OK when it does not; UNAVAILABLE when nothing could be observed.

observed.description: What the rule measured; null exactly when status is UNAVAILABLE.

evidence.description: The source records behind the observation, for links to them. Shares: the assets of the largest category, or the LOW ones. Debt: every liability. Due: every date within the window when ATTENTION, else the nearest one. Valuation: every stale asset oldest first when ATTENTION, else the oldest. Rate: the rate, then every USD record it converts. Unavailable for want of a rate: the USD records that need one.

unavailableReason.description: Why nothing could be observed; null unless status is UNAVAILABLE.

SnapshotInsightEvidence.description: One source record and the figures the rule read from it.

sourceId.description: GET /api/v1/assets/{id} or /api/v1/liabilities/{id} reads it; null for EXCHANGE_RATE, which GET /api/v1/settings/exchange-rate reads.

category.description: The asset or liability category code; null for EXCHANGE_RATE.

liquidity.description: HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW for an asset; null otherwise.

dateKind.description: Which date this row carries: an asset's VALUATION_DATE, a liability's UPDATED_ON (the day in timeZone it was last saved), NEXT_PAYMENT_DATE, MATURITY_DATE, or the RATE_EFFECTIVE_DATE.

ageDays.description: asOfDate minus date, for VALUATION_DATE, UPDATED_ON and RATE_EFFECTIVE_DATE; null otherwise.

daysUntilDue.description: date minus asOfDate, for NEXT_PAYMENT_DATE and MATURITY_DATE, negative when overdue; null otherwise.

overdue.description: date is before asOfDate; set on due rows only.

amount.description: In the record's currency: an asset's value, a liability's outstanding balance, the recurring payment for NEXT_PAYMENT_DATE (null when none is stated) or the balance for MATURITY_DATE; null for EXCHANGE_RATE.

amountVnd.description: amount in VND; null when amount is null or it is USD without a declared rate.

usdToVndRate.description: VND for one USD, on the EXCHANGE_RATE row only.

SnapshotInsightObserved.description: The measured value and how it was obtained.

value.description: A FRACTION with six decimals, HALF_UP (0.624896 is 62.4896 %), or whole DAYS (negative for an overdue due date).

subject.description: The largest asset category for CATEGORY_CONCENTRATION; null otherwise.

numeratorVnd.description: For a FRACTION, the VND amount divided; null for DAYS.

denominatorVnd.description: For a FRACTION, the VND amount divided by; null for DAYS.

date.description: For DAYS, the date counted: the nearest due date, the oldest valuation date or the rate's effective date; null for a FRACTION.

SnapshotInsightThreshold.description: The system reference threshold the rule was judged against.

comparison.description: GREATER_THAN: ATTENTION when observed.value > value. AT_MOST: ATTENTION when observed.value <= value.

SnapshotInsightThresholds.description: Every system reference threshold in force, configured centrally under rikkaus.snapshot.insights. Returned so a result can be reproduced after the configuration changes.

maxCategoryShare.description: CATEGORY_CONCENTRATION is ATTENTION above this share.

maxDebtToAssetRatio.description: DEBT_TO_ASSET_RATIO is ATTENTION above this ratio.

maxLowLiquidityShare.description: LOW_LIQUIDITY_SHARE is ATTENTION above this share.

dueWindowDays.description: UPCOMING_LIABILITY_DUE is ATTENTION when the nearest due date is at most this many days after asOfDate, an overdue one included.

maxValuationAgeDays.description: STALE_VALUATION is ATTENTION above this age in days.

maxExchangeRateAgeDays.description: STALE_EXCHANGE_RATE is ATTENTION above this age in days.

SnapshotInsightsResponse.description: The six wealth snapshot insight rules judged for the signed-in user, with their evidence.

asOfDate.description: Today in timeZone; every age and due day counts from it.

timeZone.description: The zone asOfDate is read in.

complete.description: The wealth snapshot's own flag: false when a USD record could not be converted for want of a declared rate.

insights.description: Always six, in the order CATEGORY_CONCENTRATION, DEBT_TO_ASSET_RATIO, LOW_LIQUIDITY_SHARE, UPCOMING_LIABILITY_DUE, STALE_VALUATION, STALE_EXCHANGE_RATE.

DeletionImpact.description: What deleting this record does to other stored records and to computed views, read from the database at the moment of the request.

recordType.description: The kind of record being deleted.

confirmationRequired.description: True when at least one linkedEffects entry is UNLINKED. A DELETE of this record then answers 409 linked-records unless it carries confirm=true.

linkedEffects.description: Stored records the delete removes or changes. Only kinds with at least one affected record appear.

derivedEffects.description: Computed views that will no longer include this record. Descriptive: nothing is stored for them and nothing is counted.

LinkedRecordEffect.description: One kind of stored record the delete reaches, and what happens to it.

effect.description: DELETED: removed together with the record. UNLINKED: kept, with the field named in field set to null.

field.description: For UNLINKED, the response member that becomes null on each affected record. Null for DELETED.

count.description: How many records are affected. Always at least 1.

records.description: The affected records, for UNLINKED. Empty for DELETED, where only the count is given.

LinkedRecordReference.description: An affected record, identified for display.

label.description: The user's label for it: a liability's name, a cash-flow entry's notes. Null for an entry recorded without notes.

GoalTemplateResponse.description: A goal template: a type and the suggested defaults for a new goal of that type.

type.description: The type a goal created from this template carries.

defaultExpectedAnnualReturnPercent.description: The suggested expected annual return, in percent. A suggestion, not a promise.

defaultHorizonMonths.description: How many months from today to suggest as the target date.

amountPrefill.description: Which amount the form should suggest, and from what figure the client already holds.

GoalProjection.description: A goal's projection on today's date in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Computed on every read and never stored. The method is stated in `method` and in docs/api-contract-conventions.md.

currency.description: The currency every amount is in. Always VND.

asOfDate.description: The reference day: today in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.

timeline.description: ACTIVE when at least one contribution month remains; DUE_THIS_MONTH when the target date is today or later this month; EXPIRED when it is before asOfDate.

targetReached.description: Whether the allocated amount already meets the target amount.

completionPercent.description: currentAllocatedAmount / targetAmount × 100, rounded down to 2 decimals, at most 100.

remainingMonths.description: Contribution months from the month after asOfDate through the target month, both included. 0 when DUE_THIS_MONTH or EXPIRED.

daysPastTargetDate.description: Days since the target date. Null unless EXPIRED.

requiredMonthlyContribution.description: The level monthly contribution that reaches the target, rounded up to a whole 1,000 VND; 0.00 when nothing more is needed. Null when not ACTIVE, or when the expected return is missing and the goal is not yet funded.

contributionCoveragePercent.description: plannedMonthlyContribution / requiredMonthlyContribution × 100, rounded down to 2 decimals; 100.00 when nothing is required. Null when either is unavailable.

status.description: Coverage against the system reference thresholds in the assumptions. Null whenever the coverage is unavailable, including every DUE_THIS_MONTH and EXPIRED goal.

projectedAtTargetDate.description: The projected amount at the target date as its two parts. Null unless ACTIVE with both a planned contribution and an expected return.

calculation.description: Intermediate figures for redoing the arithmetic. Null unless ACTIVE with an expected return.

unavailableReasons.description: Why each null output is null. Empty when every output is available.

assumptions.description: Every assumption behind the projection, in a fixed order, with who supplied it.

disclaimer.description: States that the expected return is the user's assumption and is not guaranteed.
disclaimer.example: The expected annual return is the user's own assumption, not a guaranteed, promised or predicted return. Projected amounts illustrate what the entered figures would produce if that return were earned every month; actual results will differ.

GoalProjectionAssumption.description: One line of the assumption ledger.

source.description: USER_ENTERED on the goal, a SYSTEM convention, or NOT_MODELLED by the projection.

value.description: The value as canonical text: a plain decimal, an ISO date or month, or an identifier. Null when the user did not state it or it is NOT_MODELLED.

GoalProjectionBreakdown.description: The projected amount at the target date, in two parts.

fromAllocated.description: currentAllocatedAmount × g, rounded half up to 2 decimals.

fromContributions.description: plannedMonthlyContribution × (g − 1) / r, or × n when r = 0, rounded half up to 2 decimals.

gapToTarget.description: total − targetAmount. Positive is a surplus, negative a shortfall.

GoalProjectionCalculation.description: Intermediate figures, rounded for display only.

monthlyRatePercent.description: expectedAnnualReturnPercent / 12, in percent, rounded half up to 6 decimals.

growthFactor.description: g = (1 + r)^n, rounded half up to 10 decimals.

GoalProjectionMethod.description: The projection method in words, as implemented.

FinancialHealthAssumptions.description: Every input a figure depends on that is not a record, so the result can be reproduced: the day, the month, the forecast horizon, the obligation window, the category groups and the declared rate.

asOfDate.description: Today in timeZone; the default month and both windows count from it.

month.description: The month the cash-flow indicators read, YYYY-MM: the query's month or the current one.

forecastHorizon.description: The forecast FORECAST_MINIMUM_CASH_BALANCE reads: always the three months after the current one, as GET /api/v1/cash-flow-forecast without from, whatever month is asked for.

obligationWindow.description: asOfDate to asOfDate plus thresholds.dueWindowDays, both included: where LIQUIDITY_SHORT_FOR_UPCOMING_OBLIGATIONS looks for obligations.

liquidAssetCategories.description: The asset categories of the liquid group, the reserve's numerator.

cashAccountCategories.description: The asset categories the forecast starts from and the liquidity rule compares with what falls due.

essentialCategories.description: The expense categories counted as essential, configured under rikkaus.cashflow.health.essential-categories.

debtPaymentCategories.description: The only categories counted as debt payments; a HOUSING entry linked to the same loan is not added.

exchangeRate.description: The declared USD/VND rate every USD record was converted with; null when none is declared.

FinancialHealthCalculation.description: How the value was obtained and the records behind it.

numeratorVnd.description: The VND amount divided: the sum of the NUMERATOR or SHARE_PART sources with an amountVnd. null for the minimum balance and when UNAVAILABLE.

denominatorVnd.description: The VND amount divided by: the sum of the DENOMINATOR sources' monthly equivalents for the reserve, the month's total income or expense for a share or the burden. null for the minimum balance and when UNAVAILABLE.

referenceVnd.description: For FORECAST_MINIMUM_CASH_BALANCE: the month of recurring essential expense the value is banded against (OK at and above it, WATCH from zero, ATTENTION below zero); null otherwise or when it cannot be known.

observedOn.description: For FORECAST_MINIMUM_CASH_BALANCE: the earliest date the lowest balance is reached.

sources.description: The records behind the figure, a USD one without a declared rate with amountVnd null. Reserve: liquid assets (NUMERATOR) and recurring essential expenses (DENOMINATOR). Burden: debt payments (NUMERATOR) and income occurrences (DENOMINATOR). Shares: the month's income or expense occurrences, SHARE_PART or SHARE_REST. Minimum balance: OPENING_BALANCE accounts, then every PROJECTED_INCOME and PROJECTED_EXPENSE amount up to observedOn, so the opening balance plus them is value.

FinancialHealthExchangeRate.description: The declared rate: VND for one USD, and the day the user says it was true.

indicatorId.description: A stable constant the client maps to its copy.

availability.description: COMPLETE: every input read and converted. PARTIAL: computed from what could be converted, a USD record left out for want of a rate (or, for the minimum balance, a forecast record the user can fix). UNAVAILABLE: nothing could be computed.

value.description: MONTHS at one decimal, a FRACTION at six (HALF_UP), or VND at two; null exactly when UNAVAILABLE. Never 0 in place of a missing denominator.

band.description: OK, WATCH or ATTENTION against thresholds (the minimum balance against calculation.referenceVnd and zero); HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW for PASSIVE_INCOME_SHARE, informational only. null when not determined.

bandNotDeterminedReason.description: Why band is null; null when band is set.

unavailableReason.description: Why nothing could be computed; set exactly when UNAVAILABLE.

partialReason.description: What the value leaves out; set exactly when PARTIAL.

value.description: Spending: income minus expense, VND. Forecast: the lowest projected balance, VND. Reserve, burden: the indicator's value. Liquidity: cash and bank accounts, VND. Concentration: the largest category's share, FRACTION.

subject.description: The largest income category for INCOME_CONCENTRATION; null otherwise.

date.description: The date of the lowest balance for FORECAST_CASH_NEGATIVE; null otherwise.

FinancialHealthResponse.description: The signed-in user's five financial-health indicators and six insight rules for one month.

indicators.description: Always five, in the order EMERGENCY_RESERVE_MONTHS, DEBT_PAYMENT_BURDEN, FORECAST_MINIMUM_CASH_BALANCE, PASSIVE_INCOME_SHARE, ESSENTIAL_EXPENSE_SHARE.

rules.description: Always six, in the order SPENDING_EXCEEDS_INCOME, FORECAST_CASH_NEGATIVE, RESERVE_BELOW_REFERENCE, HIGH_DEBT_PAYMENT_BURDEN, LIQUIDITY_SHORT_FOR_UPCOMING_OBLIGATIONS, INCOME_CONCENTRATION.

status.description: ATTENTION when observed.value compares with threshold.value as threshold.comparison says; OK when it does not; NOT_EVALUATED when it could not be judged. Never OK over a partial or unavailable input.

dependsOn.description: The indicator whose value the rule judges; null when it reads the records itself.

observed.description: What the rule measured; null exactly when NOT_EVALUATED.

evidence.description: The records behind the judgement. A rule on an indicator: that indicator's sources. Spending: the month's occurrences. Liquidity: the CASH_ACCOUNT assets, then every PAYMENT_DUE and MATURITY_DUE in the window by date. Concentration: the occurrences of the largest category.

notEvaluatedReason.description: Why the rule was not judged; set exactly when NOT_EVALUATED.

FinancialHealthSource.description: One source record and the figures read from it.

date.description: The occurrence date of a month's line, the effective date of a recurring essential expense, an asset's valuation date, a projected date, or a due date.

amountVnd.description: amount in VND; null when it is USD and no rate is declared.

cadence.description: MONTHLY, QUARTERLY or YEARLY for a recurring entry, a liability's payment frequency; null for a one-time entry or an asset.

monthlyEquivalentVnd.description: For a reserve DENOMINATOR row: amountVnd divided by the months its cadence spans (1, 3 or 12), HALF_UP to two decimals; null otherwise.

FinancialHealthThreshold.description: What the rule was judged against.

comparison.description: LESS_THAN: ATTENTION when observed.value < value. GREATER_THAN: when >.

value.description: Zero for spending and forecast, a configured value, or for liquidity the VND sum of the obligations in assumptions.obligationWindow; null only when that sum holds a USD amount with no declared rate.

property.description: The rikkaus.cashflow.health property the value comes from (for liquidity, the window it is summed over); null for a threshold fixed by the rule.

FinancialHealthThresholds.description: Every system reference value in force, configured centrally under rikkaus.cashflow.health. The review fixture of design #81, not an approved business configuration. A value equal to a limit is not beyond it.

reserveOkMinMonths.description: EMERGENCY_RESERVE_MONTHS is OK at and above this.

minReserveMonths.description: EMERGENCY_RESERVE_MONTHS is ATTENTION below this and WATCH from here to reserveOkMinMonths; RESERVE_BELOW_REFERENCE fires below it.

debtBurdenOkMax.description: DEBT_PAYMENT_BURDEN is OK at and below this.

maxDebtPaymentBurden.description: DEBT_PAYMENT_BURDEN is WATCH up to this and ATTENTION above it; HIGH_DEBT_PAYMENT_BURDEN fires above it.

passiveIncomeHighMin.description: PASSIVE_INCOME_SHARE is HIGH at and above this.

passiveIncomeMediumMin.description: PASSIVE_INCOME_SHARE is MEDIUM at and above this, LOW below.

essentialShareOkMax.description: ESSENTIAL_EXPENSE_SHARE is OK at and below this.

essentialShareWatchMax.description: ESSENTIAL_EXPENSE_SHARE is WATCH up to this and ATTENTION above it.

dueWindowDays.description: The days after asOfDate an obligation still counts as upcoming.

MonthlyCashFlowReport.description: Income, expense, net, composition and passive income of one calendar month, in VND.

from.description: The first day of the month, included.

to.description: The last day of the month, included.

currency.description: The currency every amount except originalAmount and unconverted is in.

exchangeRate.description: The USD/VND rate the user has declared, applied to every USD line. Null when none is declared, in which case no USD line is converted.

complete.description: False when a USD line could not be converted for lack of a rate. The totals then cover only the converted lines and unconverted says what was left out.

incomeComposition.description: Income by category, largest amount first, then by category name.

expenseComposition.description: Expense by category, largest amount first, then by category name.

occurrences.description: Every occurrence in the month, ordered by date and then by sourceEntryId, as GET /api/v1/cash-flow-occurrences orders them.

MonthlyCashFlowReportAssetIncome.description: One asset's linked income in the month.

assetId.description: The asset; GET /api/v1/assets/{assetId} reads its name.

amount.description: Sum of the lines linked to this asset.

sharePercentOfIncome.description: amount as a percent of total income, one decimal, rounded on its own.

MonthlyCashFlowReportCategoryShare.description: One category's part of its type's total.

amount.description: Sum of the category's converted lines.

sharePercent.description: Percent of the type's total at one decimal. The rows of one composition are apportioned by largest remainder so they sum to exactly 100.0. Null when the type's total is zero.

occurrenceCount.description: How many lines of the month are in this category.

partial.description: True when a line of this category is unconverted and left out of amount.

MonthlyCashFlowReportLine.description: One occurrence in the month, traceable to its entry by sourceEntryId and occurrenceDate.

sequence.description: Position in the entry's series, 1 for a one-time entry.

linkedAssetId.description: The asset the entry is linked to. Null when it has none.

notes.description: The entry's note. Null when it has none.

originalAmount.description: The entry's amount in its own currency.

amount.description: The amount in VND: the original for a VND entry, originalAmount times exchangeRate.usdToVndRate rounded half-up to whole dong for a USD one. Null for a USD entry when no rate is declared.

MonthlyCashFlowReportPassiveIncome.description: Income linked to an asset, grouped by that asset. Passive income is decided by the link the user entered, never inferred from a category.

sharePercentOfIncome.description: total as a percent of total income, one decimal. Null when there is no income.

byAsset.description: One row per linked asset, largest amount first, then by assetId.

MonthlyCashFlowReportRate.description: The declared rate the report applied.

usdToVndRate.description: How many VND one USD buys.

effectiveDate.description: The date the user declared the rate took effect.

MonthlyCashFlowReportTotals.description: The month's totals over converted lines.

income.description: Sum of the INCOME lines' amount.

expense.description: Sum of the EXPENSE lines' amount.

net.description: income minus expense, and nothing else. Negative when spending exceeds income.

MonthlyCashFlowReportUnassigned.description: Income in RENTAL_INCOME, DIVIDEND, DEPOSIT_INTEREST or BOND_OR_FUND_INCOME with no asset link. Shown so it can be linked; not counted in passive income.

MonthlyCashFlowReportUnconverted.description: The USD lines left out of every total because no rate is declared.

occurrenceCount.description: How many lines have a null amount.

income.description: Sum of the unconverted INCOME lines' originalAmount, in USD.

expense.description: Sum of the unconverted EXPENSE lines' originalAmount, in USD.

CashFlowOccurrenceResponse.description: A date on which one of the signed-in user's cash-flow entries applies.

sourceEntryId.description: The entry this occurrence comes from; GET /api/v1/cash-flow-entries/{id} reads it.

occurrenceDate.description: The calendar date the occurrence falls on.

sequence.description: The occurrence's position in its entry's series, counted from the effective date. Always 1 for a one-time entry.

shiftedToMonthEnd.description: True when the entry's day of month does not exist in this month, so the occurrence was moved back to the month's last day.

entryType.description: INCOME or EXPENSE, as on the entry.

amount.description: The entry's amount, in its own currency. Always positive.

currency.description: The currency the amount is expressed in.

recurrence.description: MONTHLY, QUARTERLY or YEARLY for a recurring entry. Null for a one-time one.

CashFlowForecastHorizon.description: The three whole calendar months the forecast covers.

CashFlowForecastItem.description: One projected amount and the record it comes from.

direction.description: INCOME raises the projected cash, EXPENSE lowers it.

sourceId.description: The record; GET /api/v1/cash-flow-entries/{id} or /api/v1/liabilities/{id} reads it.

amount.description: The amount in the record's own currency.

amountVnd.description: The amount in VND, rounded to whole đồng.

cadence.description: MONTHLY, QUARTERLY or YEARLY for an entry; MONTHLY, QUARTERLY, SEMIANNUAL or YEARLY for a liability; null for a one-time entry.

sequence.description: The date's position in the record's series: counted from an entry's effective date, or from a liability's next payment date.

shiftedToMonthEnd.description: True when the record's day of month does not exist in this month.

CashFlowForecastMonth.description: One calendar month of the horizon.

income.description: The VND sum of the month's INCOME items.

expense.description: The VND sum of the month's EXPENSE items.

openingBalance.description: Projected cash at the start of the month's first day.

closingBalance.description: Projected cash at the end of the month's last day.

lowestBalance.description: The lowest of the month's opening balance and every end-of-day balance on a day an amount lands.

lowestBalanceDate.description: The earliest date the lowest balance is reached.

partial.description: True when an excluded record would have contributed to this month: a liability falling due in it without a schedule, or a USD amount without a rate.

items.description: Ordered by date, then CASH_FLOW_ENTRY before LIABILITY, then sourceId.

CashFlowForecastOpeningBalance.description: The cash the projection starts from, applied at the start of the horizon's first day.

amount.description: The sum of the counted sources, in VND.

appliedOn.description: The first day of the horizon.

sources.description: The cash and bank accounts counted, ordered by sourceId. A USD account without a declared rate is in excludedSources instead.

CashFlowForecastOpeningSource.description: A cash or bank account counted in the opening balance.

valuationDate.description: The date the user states the value was true.

amount.description: The value in the asset's own currency.

CashFlowForecastResponse.description: A three-month projection of the signed-in user's cash from the records they can see.

excludedSources.description: Records that could have contributed and do not, each with its reason. Ordered by sourceType, then sourceId.

partial.description: True when any month is partial or a cash or bank account could not be counted in the opening balance.

CashFlowForecastAssumptions.description: The inputs the projection rests on.

asOfDate.description: The day the forecast was computed, in timeZone.

timeZone.description: The zone today is read in.

currency.description: The currency every total is expressed in.

exchangeRate.description: The rate USD amounts were converted with. Null when the user has declared none.

openingBalanceCategories.description: The asset categories the opening balance is made of.

notProjected.description: The days between today and the horizon that are not projected. Null when there are none.

CashFlowForecastDateRange.description: A range of calendar days, both included.

CashFlowForecastExchangeRate.description: The user-declared USD/VND rate the forecast used.

usdToVndRate.description: How many VND one USD buys.

effectiveDate.description: The date the user declares the rate took effect.

CashFlowForecastExclusion.description: A record that could have contributed to the forecast and does not.

affectedMonths.description: The horizon months it would have contributed to, when known. Each is marked partial.

linkedEntryIds.description: For COVERED_BY_LINKED_ENTRIES, the recurring entries linked to the liability that count it instead. Empty otherwise.

CashFlowForecastMinimumBalance.description: The lowest projected cash position in the horizon and how it reads.

date.description: The earliest date the lowest position is reached.

negative.description: True when the lowest position is below zero.

referenceThreshold.description: One month of projected expense: the horizon's expense divided by three.

status.description: INSUFFICIENT_DATA when no cash or bank account was counted; else NEGATIVE below zero, THIN below the threshold, ADEQUATE otherwise.

X-Correlation-Id.description: Correlation identifier. Send one matching ^[A-Za-z0-9-]{8,64}$ to have it echoed; anything else is replaced with a generated value and the request still succeeds. Always returned.

bearerAuth.description: The access token returned by /api/v1/auth/google or /api/v1/auth/refresh. Short-lived; renew with the refresh token rather than waiting for a 401.
